notes.title: Neptunian Donut Becomes Free in 2020!
notes.notes:
OK guys, Neptunian Donut becomes free in 2020! 
I sent a request to Steam and in about a week everyone will be able to get it for free. I am starting to work on the craziest, the hardest and most incredible sequel and I want as many gamers as possible to try the first part for free! Great Thanks all the gamers who bought my game and supported me! Especially guys from Japan! You are the best!
